verdict.rationale: Netlify documents first-party natural-language operation: users can prompt AI agents from the dashboard to fix, update and ship code, describe a project to have an agent build it, and connect AI assistants to their account for deployment workflows. The evidence does not show natural language driving the wider platform, such as DNS, env vars, rollbacks or domains, and all of it is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documented NL control of platform operations beyond code and ship workflows, depth on what connected assistants can actually do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Prompt AI agents to fix, update, and ship code using your unique project context directly from your Netlify dashboard.
Describe what you want to build. An AI agent handles the rest.
Start a new project with an AI agent, a Git repository, or drag and drop.
Share context & connect AI assistants to your Netlify account for seamless deployment workflows.
